gaps.explanation: Statement p5 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds) prints Transfers in (out) net per fund: General 6,570, Street (2,000), Sales Tax (26,570), Community Projects (8,000), Debt Service 30,000; ins 6,570 + 30,000 = 36,570. detail[] takes the General Fund from the General Fund Departments combining statement (pp15-16), which prints the General Fund transfers gross per department: Administrative 14,570 (p15) and Economic Development (8,000) (p16), Total 6,570. Schedule transfers in = Administrative 14,570 + Debt Service 30,000 = 44,570; gap -8,000 = the Economic Development department's (8,000), which the statement nets inside the General Fund's 6,570 (14,570 - 8,000 = 6,570). Both are printed amounts; no line is missing or duplicated (Community Projects Fund (8,000), Street (2,000), Sales Tax (26,570) and Debt Service 30,000 are each in detail[] once).

Same cause as transfers_in: statement p5 transfers out = Street 2,000 + Sales Tax 26,570 + Community Projects 8,000 = 36,570. Schedule transfers out = Economic Development department (8,000) (p16, General Fund Departments combining statement, gross) + Street (2,000) + Sales Tax (26,570) + Community Projects Fund (8,000) = 44,570; gap -8,000 = the General Fund's gross departmental transfer out, which the statement nets against Administrative 14,570 (General Fund net 6,570).

detail[] has no business-type lines. Trimmed p7 (Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds) prints Water Fund, Sewer Fund and Trash Fund columns; only operating revenue row is Consumer sales: Water 315,879 + Sewer 157,896 + Trash 71,327 = 545,102 = JSON business receipts (gap 0). No nonoperating or transfer rows are printed.
